svg.title: Selection and resistance share equal desk space
svg.desc: Give thesis-driven selection and evidentiary resistance equal desk area. Neither receives a winning checkmark; the tension remains part of the method.

**Frame:** Two labels share the desk: `THESIS SHAPES SELECTION` and `EVIDENCE CAN RESIST THESIS`. Neither wins the frame.

**Caption:**
> A STARTING BIAS DOES NOT MAKE EVERY CLAIM FALSE.
>
> HIDING IT WOULD MAKE THE CLAIMS HARDER TO EVALUATE.
